resources.string: Switch off to stop all contact with your RomM server. Your address, token and platform mapping are kept.
RomM is off: nothing is sent to the server and RomM badges, shelves and sections are hidden. Switch on to continue where you left off.
Off stops every RomM call (scans, covers, saves, downloads). Nothing is deleted.
RomM is off: RomM platforms are skipped by scans and downloads. Games you already downloaded stay in the library.
